info.title: Banking Management API
info.description:
A comprehensive API for banking management applications.

## Features
* User authentication & authorization (JWT)
* Account management (checking, savings, credit)
* Fund transfers (internal & external)
* Bill payments & scheduled payments
* Transaction history & statements
* Beneficiary management
* Card management
* Loan applications & tracking

## Authentication
This API uses JWT Bearer tokens. Obtain a token via `/auth/login`.

openedAt.description: Timestamp when the account was opened.

customerId.description: ID of the customer who owns this account.

initialDeposit.description: Initial deposit amount for the new account.

AccountStatement.description: Summary of an account's financial activity over a period.

accountId.description: ID of the account for which the statement is generated.

periodStart.description: Start date of the statement period.

closingBalance.description: Account balance at the end of the period.

totalDebits.description: Total amount debited from the account during the period.

transactions.description: List of transactions within the statement period.

amount.description: The amount of money involved in the transaction.

description.description: A brief description of the transaction.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the transaction was initiated.

completedAt.description: Timestamp when the transaction was completed.

reference.description: An optional reference code for the transaction.

accountId.description: ID of the account associated with this transaction.

counterparty.description: Other party involved in the transaction (e.g., merchant, beneficiary).

TransferRequest.description: Request body for an internal fund transfer.

description.description: A brief description for the transfer.

scheduledFor.description: Optional: If provided, schedules the transfer for a future date/time.

ExternalTransferRequest.description: Request body for an external fund transfer to a beneficiary.

description.description: A brief description for the transfer.

TransferResponse.description: Response body after initiating a fund transfer.

transactionId.description: The ID of the created transaction.

message.description: A descriptive message about the transfer status.

scheduledDate.description: Only present if the transfer was scheduled for a future date.

ScheduledTransfer.description: Details of a scheduled fund transfer.

id.description: Unique identifier for the scheduled transfer.

fromAccountId.description: ID of the account from which funds will be transferred.

toAccountId.description: ID of the account to which funds will be transferred (for internal transfers).

beneficiaryId.description: ID of the external beneficiary (for external transfers).

amount.description: The amount of money to be transferred.

description.description: A brief description of the transfer.

scheduledFor.description: The date and time when the transfer is scheduled to occur.

Beneficiary.description: Details of a registered beneficiary for transfers.

nickname.description: A friendly nickname for the beneficiary.

bankCode.description: SWIFT/BIC code of the beneficiary's bank.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the beneficiary was added.

AddBeneficiaryRequest.description: Request body for adding a new beneficiary.

nickname.description: A friendly nickname for the beneficiary.

bankCode.description: SWIFT/BIC code of the beneficiary's bank.

PaymentRequest.description: Request body for making a bill payment.

accountId.description: ID of the account from which the payment will be made.

dueDate.description: The date the payment is due.

description.description: A brief description for the payment.

recurrence.description: How often the payment should recur.

Payee.description: Details of a registered payee for bill payments.

name.description: Full name or organization name of the payee.

accountNumber.description: Payee's account number or biller ID.

bankCode.description: Bank code of the payee's bank (if applicable).

isRecurring.description: Indicates if payments to this payee are typically recurring.

Card.description: Details of a debit or credit card.

dailyLimit.description: Daily spending limit for the card.

monthlyLimit.description: Monthly spending limit for the card.

accountId.description: ID of the account linked to this card.

issuedAt.description: Timestamp when the card was issued.

CardTransaction.description: Details of a transaction made using a card.

id.description: Unique identifier for the card transaction.

merchantName.description: Name of the merchant where the transaction occurred.

cardId.description: ID of the card used for the transaction.

id.description: Unique identifier for the loan application.

customerId.description: ID of the customer who submitted the application.

amountRequested.description: The amount of loan requested by the customer.

amountApproved.description: The amount of loan approved (if applicable).

interestRate.description: Approved interest rate for the loan.

status.description: Current status of the loan application.

loanType.description: Type of loan being applied for.
